title: In M2 or M3 Districts
previewText:
M2 M3

In the districts indicated, and within 200 feet of a Residence District boundary, open storage of materials or products shall be permitted only if effectively screened by a solid wall or fence (including solid entrance and exit gates) at least eight feet in height. blocks.html: In the districts indicated, and within 200 feet of a Residence District boundary, open storage of materials or products shall be permitted only if effectively screened by a solid wall or fence (including solid entrance and exit gates) at least eight feet in height. Beyond 200 feet of a Residence District boundary, open storage of materials or products need not be screened. In either instance, any enclosure requirements set forth in Sections 42-11 through 42-20 need not apply.

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Economic Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Relocated enclosure or screening of storage in M2 or M3 districts from Section 42-422; updated to clarify rules beyond 200 feet
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to support economic growth and resiliency by providing businesses with additional zoning flexibility to locate and expand
